items.title: Why Is AutoZone (AZO) Replacing Its CFO After Jamere Jackson's Exit?
items.summary: AutoZone (NYSE:AZO) said Chief Financial Officer Jamere Jackson will resign to become CFO at FedEx. The retailer appointed Vice President and Controller J. Scott Murphy as principal accounting officer and principal financial officer. AutoZone disclosed the executive changes in a recent filing, describing Murphy as assuming the expanded finance responsibilities immediately. The shift from Jamere Jackson to J. items.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
items.summary: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.

items.title: EBay trims Depop shipping rates, bolsters delivery features
items.summary: The company is using AI to enable fast-but-reliable delivery promises and help sellers determine shipping costs more easily, CEO Jamie Iannone said.

items.title: United Parcel Stock Up Over 9% Since Strong Q3: Buy for More Upside?
items.summary: UPS stock has gained in excess of 9% since its strong Q3 results, fueled by profit growth and cost savings. Yet weak volumes and dividend concerns cloud its near-term outlook.
